bio: Since the days of their apprenticeship, the chef and sommelier have encouraged each other through friendly rivalry. Their decision to locate DIALOGUE in a residential area stems from their desire to become a familiar face to the region. Lunches are prix fixe; dinners, à la carte. Much-loved French standards populate the menu. True to its name, the restaurant offers a sprawling menu in hopes that the choices available will stimulate conversation. The fun of choosing and the joy of tasting bring hearts together....
